exact_sections.name: Welcome to Mathu's surprise
exact_sections.description: Kinetic luxury hero with signature line-by-line reveal, animated heart motif, floating champagne sparkle particles, and audio music player toggle (Nithin & Mathu's song).
key_elements: Subline: '2½ years of magical memories, endless laughs, and infinite love'
CTA buttons: 'Explore Our Story' & 'Listen to Our Melody'
Floating personalized badges: 'Nithin ♥ Mathu', 'Nov 17, 2026', '912+ Days Together'

exact_sections.name: Live birthday countdown
exact_sections.description: Real-time precise countdown timer (Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds) ticking down to November 17, 2026 with rose gold glass cards and celebratory sparkles.
key_elements: Personalized status note: 'Counting down every single second until my Pappuma's special day!'
Milestone counter: 912+ Days of pure bliss

exact_sections.name: Our 2½ Years Journey
exact_sections.description: Interactive horizontal or vertical curved timeline tracing key milestones of Nithin & Mathu's 2.5 year love story.
milestones: Day 1: The First Hello — The moment Nithin's world changed forever
Month 6: Our First Trip — Sunset walks and endless laughter
Year 1: 365 Days of Love — Learning each other's favorite coffee and secret jokes
Year 2: Growing Stronger Together — Supporting each other through every thick and thin
Year 2.5 (Today): Pappuma's Birthday Celebration — 912+ days and forever to go!

exact_sections.name: Our Memories
exact_sections.description: Editorial photo gallery with spotlight frame effects, polaroid tilt cards, soft grain overlay, light zoom on hover, and lightbox view.
exact_sections.visual_style: Clipped aesthetic frames, soft drop shadows, champagne rose borders

exact_sections.name: 10 Reasons I Love You

3. How we can talk for hours about absolutely nothing
4. Your kind and compassionate heart that cares for everyone
5. The warmth of your hugs that feel like coming home
6. 2½ years of being my best friend and soulmate
7. The way your eyes sparkle when you laugh out loud
8. How you make every ordinary day feel like a special adventure
9. Your endless patience and love for Nithin
10. Simply because you are Mathu — my one and only Pappuma🤍

exact_sections.name: A Letter to My Pappuma
exact_sections.description: An intimate, handwritten-style romantic envelope that unfolds into a heartfelt love letter from Nithin to Mathu with soft ambient lighting.
exact_sections.letter_preview: My Dearest Pappuma, 2 and a half years ago, you walked into my life and turned every ordinary moment into poetry...

🎟️ Movie Night with Unlimited Snacks & Cuddles

exact_sections.name: Locked Birthday Reveal
exact_sections.description: Exclusive secret reveal card with countdown lock for Nov 17, 2026 + instant Secret Passcode Override ('PAPPUMA2026' or 'LOVE') for Nithin/Mathu to unlock preview right now.

testing_and_data_attributes.rule: All interactive buttons, modals, cards, tabs, and form elements MUST include clear data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the recipient names: Mathu (Pappuma🤍) and sender Nithin.
Strictly include all 8 requested exact sections without omitting any.
Use Javascript (.js / .jsx) components as configured in the existing codebase.
Ensure contrast compliance for text on warm champagne/ivory backgrounds.
Include live music control toggle with ambient romantic soundtrack.
Include secret unlock code 'PAPPUMA2026' or 'MATHU' for immediate birthday reveal testing.
